definition: Pool intended for swimming or recreation.
note: Record completion, shared/private access and any fees; do not infer size.

definition: Pool explicitly described as intended for children.
note: Does not establish depth, supervision or safety certification.

definition: Dedicated exercise room or fitness facility.
note: Record equipment and paid access separately if known.

definition: Dry-heat bathing facility.
note: Do not map a steam room to a sauna automatically.

definition: Humid-heat bathing facility.
note: Separate from sauna; verify operating status.

definition: Dedicated outdoor children's play space.
note: Does not imply supervised childcare.

definition: Dedicated indoor children's play space.
note: Childcare and supervised services require separate claims.

definition: Shared space explicitly offered for work.
note: Does not imply bookable private offices or included internet.

definition: Room offered for meetings.
note: Record booking requirements and charges.

definition: Parking spaces available at the property site.
note: Does not imply an assigned bay, covered parking or free use.

definition: Parking spaces protected by a roof or structure.
note: Do not infer enclosed or assigned parking.

definition: Equipment explicitly intended to charge electric vehicles.
note: Verify connector, capacity, operation and fees separately.

definition: Designated space for keeping bicycles.
note: Does not imply a locked room or theft insurance.

definition: Passenger lift serving the building.
note: A lift alone does not prove a continuous step-free route.

definition: An explicitly described entrance route without steps.
note: Not an accessibility certification; verify slopes, widths and route continuity.

definition: Staffed assistance described as concierge service.
note: Do not infer 24-hour coverage or included personal services.

definition: A staffed reception point.
note: Record working hours; reception is not equivalent to concierge.

definition: On-site staff explicitly assigned a security role.
note: Do not infer hours, response time or a safety guarantee.

definition: Cameras described as monitoring part of the site.
note: Does not establish complete coverage, retention or live monitoring.

definition: An explicit access-control mechanism for entry.
note: Specify card, intercom or other mechanism if known.

definition: An alternative power supply for some circuits.
note: Record covered circuits and duration; do not promise whole-unit continuity.

definition: Photovoltaic electricity generation at the property.
note: Separate from solar water heating; capacity may be unknown.

definition: Water-storage capacity explicitly described for the building.
note: Storage alone does not establish potability or guaranteed supply.

definition: An offered internet connection or service.
note: Do not infer included subscription, speed or availability in every unit.

definition: Air-conditioning equipment provided in the unit.
note: Record rooms, included installation and condition separately.

definition: An exterior platform associated with the unit.
note: Do not infer usable area or combine it with internal floor area.

definition: An exterior terrace associated with the unit.
note: Distinguish private access from common roof or podium space.

definition: Garden space explicitly allocated for private use.
note: Exclusive use is not proof of land ownership.

definition: A shared room with laundry facilities.
note: Does not imply free use, serviced laundry or an in-unit washing machine.

definition: A washing machine explicitly provided in the unit.
note: Do not map communal laundry to this code.

definition: A documented policy governing animals at the property.
note: This code does not itself mean pets are allowed; retain actual policy text.

definition: An explicit route from the property directly to a beach.
note: Not equivalent to sea view, beachfront wording or legal access rights.

definition: A claimed view of the sea from the specified unit.
note: Record viewpoint and obstruction; does not mean beach access.

definition: Roof space offered for shared use.
note: Does not imply a pool, bar, private terrace or unrestricted access.

definition: A restaurant explicitly located within the site.
note: Do not infer included meals, ownership or permanent operation.

definition: A scheduled or on-demand transport service.
note: Record route, frequency, eligibility and fees instead of assuming them.

definition: Designated parcel receipt or storage provision.
note: Does not imply 24-hour collection or acceptance of valuables.
